destinations.name: Cebu
destinations.tagline: The Queen City of the South — history, waterfalls, and world-class diving.
destinations.description: Cebu is the oldest Spanish settlement in the Philippines and a perfect base for island adventures. History, waterfalls, canyoneering, and world-class diving are all within reach.
destinations.whyPopular: The oldest Spanish settlement in the Philippines mixes colonial history with world-class diving, waterfalls, and the famous Cebu lechon.
destinations.bestTime: December to May (dry season); avoid June to October rains
destinations.howToGetThere: Fly into Mactan-Cebu International Airport (CEB) from Manila, Clark, or Davao. Fastcrafts connect Cebu to Bohol and Leyte from Pier 1.

destinations.name: Bohol
destinations.tagline: Chocolate Hills, tarsiers, and some of the bluest water in the Visayas.
destinations.description: Bohol pairs iconic sights — the Chocolate Hills and wide-eyed tarsiers — with Panglao's dive sites and beaches. It's one of the easiest, most rewarding island trips in the country.
destinations.whyPopular: Famous for the Chocolate Hills and tiny tarsiers, plus Panglao's diving and Alona Beach's lively strip.
destinations.bestTime: November to April (dry season); Chocolate Hills are brownest March to May
destinations.howToGetThere: Fly into Bohol-Panglao International Airport (TAG) from Manila or Cebu. Or take a 2-hour OceanJet fastcraft from Cebu Pier 1 to Tagbilaran.

destinations.name: Boracay
destinations.tagline: The Philippines' most famous beach — powdery sand and legendary sunsets.
destinations.description: A tiny island with a huge reputation: 4 km of powder-white sand, turquoise water, and sunsets that stop conversations. Great for beach lovers and nightlife fans alike.
destinations.whyPopular: Consistently voted among the world's best beaches — 4 km of powdery white sand, clear water, and a buzzing nightlife scene.
destinations.bestTime: November to April; peak season December to February (Amihan winds)
destinations.howToGetThere: Fly into Caticlan (MPH) — 15 minutes from the jetty port — or Kalibo (KLO), then a 1.5-2 hour van ride. Take the ferry from Caticlan Jetty Port to Boracay.

places.name: Willy's Rock

places.name: Parasailing

destinations.name: Iloilo
destinations.tagline: The City of Love — heritage churches, batchoy, and festival energy.
destinations.description: Iloilo blends Spanish-era churches and ancestral homes with a proud food scene — birthplace of La Paz Batchoy. A great cultural stop before Guimaras or Gigantes.
destinations.whyPopular: Known for heritage churches, the original La Paz Batchoy, and Dinagyang — one of the country's biggest festivals.
destinations.bestTime: November to April; Dinagyang Festival in January
destinations.howToGetThere: Fly into Iloilo International Airport (ILO) from Manila or Cebu. Ferries also run from Bacolod (1 hour) and Guimaras (15 minutes).

destinations.name: Siquijor
destinations.tagline: The mystical island of fireflies, falls, and healing traditions.
destinations.description: Small, slow, and a little mystical, Siquijor is loved for waterfalls you can swing into, quiet beaches, and traditional healers. Perfect for unplugged island days.
destinations.whyPopular: A small island with a mystical reputation, drawing travelers with waterfalls, cliff jumps, and centuries-old healing rituals.
destinations.bestTime: March to May for the calmest seas and best diving
destinations.howToGetThere: Fly or take a fastcraft to Dumaguete, then a 45-minute to 1-hour ferry to Siquijor. Direct ferries also run from Cebu (3-4 hours).

destinations.name: Dumaguete
destinations.tagline: The City of Gentle People — gateway to Apo Island and Negros Oriental.
destinations.description: A friendly university town on Negros' coast with a scenic boulevard, waterfalls nearby, and easy boat access to Apo Island's famous sea turtles.
destinations.whyPopular: A relaxed university city and the jump-off point for diving Apo Island's turtle-filled reefs.
destinations.bestTime: November to April; sea conditions best March to May
destinations.howToGetThere: Fly into Dumaguete-Sibulan Airport (DGT) from Manila or Cebu. Fastcrafts connect to Cebu (4 hours) and Siquijor (under 1 hour).
